title: OPEC+ ministerial meeting (November quotas)
source: EST: opec.org press release 1835613 dated 6 September 2026, fetched direct 2026-09-07 — the seven participating countries' own statement, which records that they 'decided to maintain September 2026 required production for October 2026' and closes with the verbatim sentence 'The next meeting will be held on 4 October 2026.' Corroborated by the wire coverage of the same meeting (Reuters via kfgo.com, 2026-09-06: 'The seven OPEC+ members will convene again on October 4, 2026'; aninews.in 2026-09-07 carries the unchanged 31.1 mb/d total target). Filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep, even though the source is the group's own release. Checked 2026-09-07
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-3y-note-2026-09-08 D-0 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-07), reading the outcome of the tracked opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06. This is the QUOTA-SETTING seven-country group's own next meeting, and it is NOT the same body as the already-tracked opec-jmmc-68th-2026-10-04, which meets the same day — that entry's own notes state the distinction verbatim: the JMMC 'monitors DoC conformity and compensation and RECOMMENDS — it does not set quotas, which is the seven/eight-country group's job.' Two bodies, one date, two different decisions; the calendar tracked the advisory one and not the deciding one. Filed `medium` on the same reasoning as its 09-06 predecessor: the base case is a non-event (the group has now held the 31.1 mb/d target flat for two consecutive months and is widely expected to pause increases through Q4), and the tier reflects the consequence if that signal breaks, not its probability. What makes the October instance live is that the September one already demonstrated the group's reduced grip: OPEC+ held output steady on 09-06 and Brent nevertheless rose to a six-week high of ~$97.5 by 09-07, because the Strait of Hormuz disruption — tanker traffic at its lowest since May — is setting the price rather than the quota is. An analyst quoted in the 09-06 wire coverage put it that the group 'currently has very limited power over the physical oil market.' Also note for whoever researches it: 10-04 is a Sunday two days before treasury-3y-note-2026-10-06 and three days before the October CPI corridor, the same pre-auction placement the 09-06 meeting had. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
